seo.title: Thank you: website audit request received
seo.description: Your free website audit request has reached Calwebtech. Here is what we check, how the findings reach you and what happens after.

title: Thanks. Your website audit request is with us.
intro: We have your website address and anything you asked us to look at. A confirmation email is on its way to the address you gave.

received.heading: What you sent us
items: The address of the website to review
Anything you asked us to look at in particular

response.label: Expect a reply
response.detail: A person confirms the review has started and tells you when the written findings will reach you.

steps.title: A person reviews your site
steps.body: We check mobile speed, accessibility, search visibility, structured data and how the site asks visitors to get in touch.

steps.title: We send you what we found
steps.body: A plain summary by email of the problems worth fixing, starting with the ones that cost you the most enquiries.

steps.title: The findings are yours
steps.body: Act on them with any team you like. If you want us to fix them, we quote a fixed price.

secondary.heading: While you wait
secondary.body: See how a redesign is run, from mapping every URL to launch day, so rankings survive the move.

image.alt: A project team planning a website with sticky notes on a whiteboard
